svg.title: Animated Zebracorn Repo Galaxy — kugguk2022 public organization map
svg.desc: A self-contained animated Repo Galaxy with a prominent Zebracorn snowboarding root, public products visible, and private-only organization surfaces redacted.
svg.metadata: Self-contained GitHub-safe SVG; the supplied MP4 is embedded as an animated WebP root with JavaScript-free declarative SVG animation.
